review_locator: PMCID:PMC7672641, L1CAM as an E-selectin Ligand in Colon Cancer; PMCID:PMC3422812, Expression of E-selectin ligands on circulating tumor cells
primary_title: Human colon-cancer cells and E-selectin-expressing CHO/endothelial comparator systems; E-selectin-Ig affinity chromatography, ligand identification, glycanase/O-sialoglycoprotease controls, LAMP-1 overexpression or plasma-membrane targeting, and adhesion assays
decision_basis: The reviews identify cell-surface LAMP-1 as an E-selectin ligand and the cited primary studies demonstrate calcium-dependent E-selectin binding/affinity isolation from colon-cancer cells, with LAMP-1 identification and expression-dependent adhesion.
limitations_preserved: Preserve cell-surface LAMP-1 and sialofucosylated glycoform context, calcium dependence, and colon-cancer adhesion model; no generalized LAMP1 trafficking or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7672641, L1CAM as an E-selectin Ligand in Colon Cancer; PMCID:PMC3422812, Expression of E-selectin ligands on circulating tumor cells
primary_title: Human colon cancer cells express multiple glycoprotein ligands for E-selectin
decision_basis: The reviews identify cell-surface LAMP-2 among the principal E-selectin-binding glycoproteins on colon-cancer cells and the cited primary affinity-isolation study identifies LAMP-2 with calcium-dependent, glycan-sensitive E-selectin binding.
limitations_preserved: Preserve cell-surface LAMP-2 glycoform and colon-cancer ligand-identification context; binding-only edge with no autonomous LAMP2 signaling or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6711759, Selectins in cancer immunity; PMCID:PMC7121831, Selectins and Associated Adhesion Proteins in Inflammatory disorders
primary_title: Carcinoembryonic antigen and CD44 variant isoforms cooperate to mediate colon carcinoma cell adhesion to E- and L-selectin in shear flow
decision_basis: The reviews identify carcinoembryonic antigen/CEACAM5 as an E-selectin ligand and the cited primary study identifies CEA by immunoaffinity chromatography and tandem mass spectrometry, then validates E-selectin binding by blot rolling and flow-based adhesion assays.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CEA/CEACAM5 glycoform, CD44v cooperation and colon-carcinoma shear-flow context; no autonomous CEACAM5 signaling or SCI inference.

primary_title: Carcinoembryonic antigen and CD44 variant isoforms cooperate to mediate colon carcinoma cell adhesion to E- and L-selectin in shear flow
decision_basis: The reviews identify carcinoembryonic antigen/CEACAM5 as an L-selectin ligand and the cited primary study validates CEA binding by blot rolling and flow-based adhesion, with CEA serving as an auxiliary L-selectin ligand in colon-carcinoma cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CEA/CEACAM5 glycoform, auxiliary-ligand and CD44v cooperation context, and colon-carcinoma shear-flow model; no autonomous CEACAM5 signaling or SCI inference.
